title: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu

zh.gap: 痛点击中了，但在离人一层的地方停住了：3317 星、736 fork——fork 超过星的五分之一，在这块板上算行为证据——说明有人在自己搭；但现在存在的是排盘引擎，不是一个人能开口问的东西。用人话讲出来的那份解读，还是缺的。
zh.pain: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎——把古籍命理变成 AI 能直接调用的结构化数据。
zh.kill: 这个品类在会付钱的那个市场里政策脆弱：国内应用商店和支付渠道对测算变现有限制，所以分发就是全部问题，而算法来自公开古籍，任何在位者都能重新推一遍。两位贡献者，对一个必须准确的知识库来说也太薄。这里还得自限——这是民俗文本不是建议，一旦滑向替人决定要不要接那份工作，就是责任。
zh.move: 别再做一个测算 app，做那层诚实的翻译。盘进去，人话出来，每一句都脚注到它出自哪一段古籍原文，并且明写这是文化文本、不是建议。别人没有的资产是结构化的原文——就靠出处站住，而这恰好是免费 app 拿不出来的东西。冷启动（中文）：小红书与豆瓣的紫微斗数小组，人们贴一张盘的截图问这是什么意思；冷启动（英文）：r/ChineseAstrology 与 r/asianastrology，同样的盘贴出来，英文世界根本没有解读。

pick_reason: The project offers a unique astrological charting engine with potential for monetization through personalized services or applications.
gap: It hits a real pain but stops one layer short of the person: 3.3k stars and 736 forks — a fork-to-star ratio above a fifth, which on this board counts as behaviour evidence — say builders are standing up their own copies, but what exists is a charting engine, not something a person asks a question of. The reading, in plain language, is still missing.
pain: The open charting engine for Zi Wei Dou Shu — classical astrology as structured data, ready for AI apps.
kill: The category is policy-fragile in the market that pays for it: Chinese app stores and payment channels restrict 测算 monetisation, so distribution is the whole problem and the algorithms are public classics any incumbent can re-derive. Two contributors is also thin for a knowledge base that has to be right. And there is a self-limit here — this is folklore, not advice; the moment it drifts into telling someone whether to take the job, it is a liability.
move: Do not build another 测算 app; build the honest translation layer. Chart in, plain-language reading out, every claim footnoted to the classical passage it came from, and an explicit line that this is a cultural text and not advice. The asset nobody else has is the structured original text — lean on provenance, which is exactly what the free apps cannot show. Cold start (Chinese): 小红书 and 豆瓣 紫微斗数 groups, where people post a chart screenshot and ask what it means; Cold start (English): r/ChineseAstrology and r/asianastrology, where the same charts are posted with no reading available in English at all.
